python3 -I -c 'import re, sys
t = open("governance/project/orchestration/tools/dispatch/launch_now.sh").read()
c = "\n".join(l for l in t.splitlines() if not l.lstrip().startswith("#"))
x = c.index("\nexec ")
e = c[x:]
ok = (c.count("--add-dir") == 2 and e.count("--add-dir") == 2
      and "\n  --add-dir \"$TESTS\" --add-dir \"$RUNS\" \\\n  --append-system-prompt-file \"$TEMPLATE\" \\\n" in e
      and re.search(r"\nTESTS=\"/home/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/gov-os-worktrees/\$W2-tests\"\n", c)
      and re.search(r"\nRUNS=\"/home/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/gov-os-runs\"\n", c)
      and c.index("resources --register") < c.index("mkdir \"$TESTS\"") < x
      and c.count("mkdir") == 1 and "GOV_ROLE\\\":\\\"orchestrator" in e
      and not any(b in c for b in ("pgrep", "pkill", "killall", "pidof", "mkdir -p", "rm ")))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'
